name: M142 HIMARS
note: Lockheed Martin M142 HIMARS wheeled multiple rocket launcher. Crew of 3. Fires a single pod of six GMLRS guided rockets or one ATACMS / PrSM ballistic missile. GMLRS range recorded as the in-service M31 figure; ATACMS as the MGM-140.

source.title: M142 HIMARS | Wikipedia
source.note: Infobox lists GMLRS 150 km (extended-range GMLRS); the in-service M31 GMLRS is commonly cited ~70-90 km. 90 km taken as the base figure.

source.note: One pod of 'six GMLRS rockets'.

name: BM-30 Smerch
note: BM-30 Smerch (9K58) 300 mm heavy multiple rocket launcher, 12 barrels. Crew of 3. Range depends on the rocket: 9M55K ~70 km, 9M528 ~90 km, guided 9M542 ~120 km, 9M544 ~200 km. Value below is the 9M528 HE-fragmentation figure.

source.title: BM-30 Smerch | Wikipedia
source.note: Rocket table: 9M55K max 70 km, 9M528 max 90 km, guided 9M542 max 120 km, 9M544 max 200 km. 90 km is the 9M528 HE-fragmentation figure.

source.title: BM-30 Smerch | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Barrels: 12'; fires a full load of 12 rockets.
